brief: A single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it, with five drawers in it.

requirements.requirement: Single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it
requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;full only - one piece at 0,0,0 level 0, total=1, counts piece=1. Verified on get_build.

Configurator offers 0 drawer sockets on a full base (find_sockets drawer total 0). A half base offers only 1 drawer socket (s40 at cut face). Notch/bay drawers require adjacent bases, which would violate 'nothing else added beside'. Max achievable on a single isolated base is 1 drawer, not 5; build retains 0 drawers to keep single full base intact.

finish.summary: Kept single full hex base at 0,0,0. Five drawers in a single base is not possible in the configurator: full base offers no drawer sockets, half-base offers one. Notch/bay frames require neighbouring bases. So 1-drawer max vs 5 requested.
